Pecasa – Premium Bespoke Garden Rooms, Made in Britain
Pecasa designs, manufactures and installs premium bespoke garden rooms, garden offices and annexes, creating beautiful, practical spaces that enhance your home and lifestyle.

From our manufacturing facility in Watford, Hertfordshire, we produce our own Structural Insulated Panels (SIPs), combining precision manufacturing, high-quality materials and experienced craftsmanship to deliver exceptional results.

Our innovative off-site manufacturing process allows us to prepare much of your garden room before installation begins. This significantly reduces on-site construction work, noise, mess and disruption to your home.

With our streamlined approach, many of our garden rooms can be installed in two weeks or less, depending on size, specification and site conditions.

Every Pecasa garden room is designed around your individual requirements, whether you need a home office, gym, entertainment space or fully equipped garden annexe.

With over 120 completed projects, we take pride in delivering beautifully finished, fully insulated spaces designed for year-round comfort and long-lasting performance.

Pecasa – Designed for You. Manufactured in Britain. Built to Last.
